summary: Confirmed the exclusion of s2_submission_depth_variation4_vs_blind and s2_submission_depth_variation4_vs_open. Both are absent from estimates and separately documented in not_extracted. PDF p. 29 (printed p. 28), Section 5 and Table 2, reports contest participant counts and aggregate submission totals, but no participant-level submission-depth contrast. Its general statement about participation does not establish a result for that outcome. PDF pp. 65-66 (printed pp. WA-21 to WA-22), Web Appendix D.1 and Table WA-D.1, concern designer characteristics and contain no submission-depth measure. The explicit submission-depth t-test statement on PDF p. 36 (printed p. 35), Appendix B, belongs to Study 1 and cannot support these Study 2 contrasts. Exclusion is consistent with extraction-spec rule 4; deriving arm means from submission totals and participant counts would violate rule 1. There are consequently no retained estimate-level statistics, counts, or coding fields to correct for these two slugs. Read the entire markdown conversion, including all appendices, and checked the cited PDF pages directly with pymupdf. The coverage review found no missing eligible outcome or contrast under rules 4-6.
